title: Book Two · Chapter 114: A Cost on Paper
story:
Miss Wu has eleven corrected guides on Tuesday. Seven copies are still outside the room. Two are at home. One belongs to a pupil's brother. Four have no clear place on Ronan's list.

“We need a new back page,” she says.

Ronan looks at the eleven thin strips. Some cover the old line neatly. On two copies the glue shows through.

“I can write on every page.”

“Yes. But two copies need a clean page. The old words show under the new ones.”

She sets those copies aside. Then she puts a small cost beside each new sheet.

“The school paid for the first copies,” she says. “You can use the same route picture. We need only these pages and a few clear correction notices.”

“Can I pay?”

“You can pay part from your own money. Talk to your parents. I will not ask them for the whole cost.”

Ronan writes down the amount. An adult can earn that amount in a short time. But for Ronan, it is a lot of money.

At home he opens the tin on the bed. The old note about Leo's reading activity lies beneath the coins. He takes out the money and counts it twice.

Mum reads the cost paper. Dad sits on the floor near the blue toolbox. A clean cloth covers one knee.

“How much will you have left?” Mum asks.

Ronan tells her.

“Then you cannot buy the new ball this month.”

“I know.”

Dad asks to see the guide. Ronan gives him a corrected copy.

“Did you think the old time was right?” Dad asks.

“At first. Later I saw the new one.”

“And you kept the old one?”

“Yes.”

Dad is silent. Ronan wishes Dad would say something. He looks down at the paper and waits.

Mum folds the cost paper once.

“We can sign this,” she says. “The money comes from your tin. You still need to do the work.”

Ronan puts the coins in a small envelope. He leaves enough for the bread he has promised to buy on Thursday.

Dad looks at the remaining coins.

“Want me to count?”

“No. Please check after me.”

Dad counts them. The two amounts match.

Ronan writes the sum on the envelope and puts it under his bag. Then he brings the tin back to the shelf.

It feels almost empty. He shakes it once by mistake. A coin taps against the side.

Mum hears it. She says nothing. She moves her sewing basket from his chair. He sits at the table and starts the first clean correction page.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

cost＝费用；amount＝数额；envelope＝信封；match＝一致。

## 理解问题

1. 付费会影响Ronan原来的什么计划？
2. 父母为什么还要求他亲自做更正工作？

## 读句子

**Dad / counts / them.** Dad／清点／它们。
